win_system.notes:
WAYS TO WIN

 The specified requirements for a winning combination in the base game are also used during bonus features or free spins play unless otherwise stated. Each wager is eligible for all winning combinations unless otherwise stated.

 You win if matching symbols appear along one of the following predefined lines on adjacent reels from left to right, starting with the leftmost reel. The number of possible lines in this game is 35. Please consult the paytable for the number of each symbol

scatters.name: MULTIPLIER LIGHTS
scatters.behavior:
Activate rows of multiplier lights for massive wins!

 Each row has an inactive multiplier displayed to the left. At the start of every spin in the base game, the multiplier gets a random value from one of the following possible values: 2x, 3x, 4x, 5x, 6x, 7x, 8x, 9x, 10x.

 When a winning combination occurs, the multiplier on each row that has symbols included in the winning combination is increased by the number of winning symbols on that row. Each winning symbol increases the multiplier by 1.

 When the Multiplier Boost scatter symbol lands it multiplies the multiplier value on the row where it landed by 2. The Epic Multiplier Boost scatter symbol multiplies all row multiplier values by 2.

 When the Lightning Bolt scatter symbol lands on a row it activates the multiplier for that row.

 When at least one symbol on an activated row is part of a winning combination, that row multiplier is applied to the win. If a winning combination includes symbols from more than one activated row, the values of the multipliers are added together before being applied to the win.

 A row’s multiplier value cannot be applied more than once per winning combination, regardless of how many winning symbols are on that row.

 When the Blackout Skull scatter symbol lands on a row it deactivates the multiplier for that row.

scatters.name: LO-FI SPINS
scatters.behavior:
Land 3 FS scatter symbols at the same time in the base game to activate this bonus feature.

 This feature begins with 3 activated rows of multiplier lights. The feature ends once all row multipliers are deactivated.

scatters.name: SPIN AND CHILL
scatters.behavior:
Land 4 FS scatter symbols at the same time in the base game to activate this bonus feature.

 This feature begins with 5 activated rows of multiplier lights. The feature ends once all row multipliers are deactivated.
